title: Comparatives 2
note: PULLED FORWARD from B2 (James dropdown 2026-09-02) - the tree files this at B2.comparatives.advanced, but as...as is common well below that. Builds on a2_comparatives / a2_superlatives. Czech tak...jako gives *as tall like me. Second job: the modifier slot before a comparative (much / far / a bit), where very is the target error. First draft 2026-09-02, rough - thicken after smoke.

cards.title: As tall as
points: You already know **-er /** more and **the -est** / the most.
These are the other ways to compare. Czech **tak… jako** becomes **as… as**, not *as… like*.

examples.cz: Je stejně vysoká jako její bratr.

examples.en: This flat isn't **as expensive** as the other one.
examples.cz: Tenhle byt není tak drahý jako ten druhý.

cards.title: less and the least
points: **less** works with any adjective, but for short ones people usually say **not as**.

rows: **not as** crowded — more common in speech

cards.title: much better, not very better
points: **very** goes with a plain adjective: very good. Never with a comparative.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: **as …** as for equal, and **much /** far / a bit before a comparative.

rows: ~~It's not so expensive as the other one.~~
It's **not as** expensive as the other one.

items.en: She's as tall as her brother.
items.cz: Je stejně vysoká jako její bratr.
items.gap: She's as tall ____ her brother. (as / like)
accepts: She's as tall as her brother.
She is as tall as her brother.
items.wrong: She's as tall like her brother.
items.explanation: The pair is **as … as**. Czech *jako* is not *like* here.
items.explanation_cz: Dvojice je **as … as**. České *jako* tady není *like*.

items.en: This flat isn't as expensive as the other one.
items.cz: Tenhle byt není tak drahý jako ten druhý.
items.gap: This flat isn't ____ expensive as the other one. (as / so)
accepts: This flat isn't as expensive as the other one.
This flat is not as expensive as the other one.

items.explanation: **much** goes before a comparative. **very** does not.

items.en: The train is far cheaper than the plane.
items.cz: Vlak je mnohem levnější než letadlo.
items.gap: The train is ____ cheaper than the plane. (far / very)
accepts: The train is far cheaper than the plane.

items.en: My flat is less crowded than yours.
items.cz: Můj byt je míň přeplněný než tvůj.
items.gap: My flat is ____ crowded than yours. (less / least)
accepts: My flat is less crowded than yours.
items.explanation: **less** + adjective + than for the smaller amount.
items.explanation_cz: **less** + přídavné jméno + than pro menší míru.

items.en: It's a bit longer than I expected.
items.cz: Je to trochu delší, než jsem čekal.
items.gap: It's ____ longer than I expected. (a bit / very)
accepts: It's a bit longer than I expected.

items.en: He isn't as fast as he used to be.
items.gap: He isn't ____ fast as he used to be. (as / so)
accepts: He isn't as fast as he used to be.
items.explanation: **not as** fast as — the standard negative equal.
items.explanation_cz: **not as** fast as — běžná záporná rovnost.

items.en: This is the least expensive option.
items.gap: This is ____ expensive option. (the least / less)
accepts: This is the least expensive option.
items.explanation: **the least** + adjective for the bottom of the group.
items.explanation_cz: **the least** + přídavné jméno pro nejnižší ve skupině.

items.en: Prague is much bigger than Brno.
items.cz: Praha je mnohem větší než Brno.
items.gap: Prague is ____ bigger than Brno. (much / very)
accepts: Prague is much bigger than Brno.
items.wrong: Prague is more bigger than Brno.

items.en: Her new job is as good as the old one.
items.cz: Její nová práce je stejně dobrá jako ta stará.
items.gap: Her new job is ____ good as the old one. (as / so)
accepts: Her new job is as good as the old one.
items.explanation: **as good as** — the two are equal.
